responsibility: Defines the core type-IR representation of Rust types and closely related support types, including primitive and composite `TyKind` variants, alias kinds, trait-object representation kinds, function signatures and headers, mutability-carrying wrappers, and the crate’s inference-type and scalar-type enums. Together with its closure submodule, it provides the structural model and helper APIs for constructing, inspecting, and formatting the main type forms manipulated by the rest of `rustc_type_ir`.
